en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a monumental, mound‑shaped memorial complex with a central staircase leading up the slope. At the front is an arched entrance facade with the inscription "VLADISLAV VARNENSI" and decorative plants. Two tall, minimalist pillars stand symmetrically in the foreground. The printed caption along the bottom edge is in Bulgarian and German and identifies the site and city.
